title: Settlement of Money Held for Room Reservations
content:
Money held for a Room Reservations reservation — a full prepayment or a resort advance deposit — leaves the advance deposit in one of four ways.

## The ways money held leaves

1. **Timely cancellation.** On a cancellation recorded before the deadline, the full amount held is refunded to the card when the plan refunds the deposit on a cancellation on or before the deadline, and retained as a forfeit when it does not.
2. **Late cancellation or no-show.** *No longer in force:* the former clause "on a late cancellation or a no-show an amount equal to the penalty is retained as a forfeit and any amount held beyond the penalty is refunded" is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis.
3. **Relocation.** On a relocation the full amount held is refunded when the plan refunds prepayments and advance deposits in full on relocation.
4. **Check-in.** At check-in whatever is still held is transferred to the guest folio as a payment.

## Limits and states

- **Amount held.** The amount held for a reservation is the total of its deposit collections less the total of its deposit refunds, forfeits and transfers, read from the reservation's charge records over its whole life up to the moment of handling. No refund, forfeit or transfer exceeds it.
- **Refund state.** *No longer in force:* the former clause "a refund is made only for a reservation whose status is cancelled or relocated" is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis.
- **Forfeit state.** A forfeit is made only for a reservation whose status is cancelled or no-show.
- **Transfer state.** A transfer is made only for a reservation whose status is in house.
- **Once only.** Each collection is refunded at most once, and each penalty is settled from held money at most once; the charge records show whether a refund already names a collection.

## Worked case (hypothetical)

A Flexible Rate reservation at an Ashbury Resort & Spa holds a 280.00 deposit collected at booking. Cancelled before the deadline on a plan that refunds the deposit, the 280.00 is refunded in full. Had the guest instead arrived, the 280.00 still held would be transferred to the folio as a payment at check-in.

| Event | Status required | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Refund on timely cancellation (deposit refundable) | cancelled | everything held |
| Forfeit on timely cancellation (deposit not refundable) | cancelled | everything held |
| Refund on relocation | relocated | everything held |
| Transfer at check-in | in house | everything still held |

superseded_clauses: A refund is made only for a reservation whose status is cancelled or relocated.
On a late cancellation or a no-show an amount equal to the penalty is retained as a forfeit and any amount held beyond the penalty is refunded.
